author: vulturish
title: Fun but it’s filled with ads, art theft, and AI
content:
The base gameplay is fun; it’s a puzzle game where you select the colors in the correct order to solve the puzzle and get to watch ants take apart pixel art block by block with fun little haptic rumbles with each ants appearance. Simple and the pixel art is a nice touch to this genre of game.

However, it’s filled with AI generated artwork/text and clearly stolen pixel art of copyright characters such as Hello Kitty and Studio Ghibli soot sprites. I would not be surprised if the entire app was AI generated code. It’s also entirely hampered by shoving every single mobile app game annoyance into it. This game is designed to bombard you with ads and it has systems in place specifically to waste your time to make you look at more ads. Examples include limited lives, levels that basically require power ups to complete, ads at the bottom of the screen all the time during play some of which darken the entire play area while flashing, random ad breaks after almost every level, 2x speed which is free in the tutorial but then requires an ad or coins to access, power ups and currency in general, random non-sensical events that try to keep you playing longer by offering prizes that offset the annoyances like unlimited lives, etc.

$7.99 for an ad free experience in an almost certainly entirely AI generated game is LUDICROUS. Not worth playing long term.

A pop up in the game  asks you to rate the game appropriately one or two levels before they start showing ads (right around maybe level 15-20 somewhere) - strategic but misleading if people are writing reviews based on their experience without ads which then immediately changes. I was also upset when after playing the game with compulsory ads for 30 or so levels with the fast-forward function being a free part of the game, I pay $7.99 for the ad free version and all of a sudden I have to watch ads to fast forward - not cool. I agree with another reviewer too who says that some levels really seem like you have to use power ups and spend more money to pass them - I can’t prove it and maybe it is possible without but - meh - I don’t like it. Maybe all of these shady dealings won’t bother you but it all put a bad taste in my mouth (especially after paying for the game).

author: Guhytfrdeswaqzxcbm
title: Levels repeat, some unbeatable
content:
I do find this game to be a lot of fun, but there are some inconsistencies and issues. 
1, the ad that lead me to download this game was deceiving. It shows the gameplay sped up, actual game play is slow. You can watch a video or pay for the speed in the demo, but otherwise this is dishonest advertising. 
2, the level images repeat, even if the color options you can select change, this gives a feeling of repetitiveness. 
3, you can watch a video of the level and repeat the moves to try to get past a difficult level and your game play will not have the same result. This shows inconsistency in play and the result is that I cannot trust all levels are actually able to be beat since winning cannot be replicated reliably. 
4, you almost never earn power ups, they’ve added a few different competitions to change this a bit but they’re still far and few in between. 

Overall I actually really enjoy this game and would like to play it more. But the way it’s built doesn’t allow for that, and because of the lack of reliability in game play outcomes I don’t have trust all levels can be beat so I don’t want to spend money on it either.

title: Incredibly fun, incredibly infuriating
content: This should be a 5 star game. It’s addicting, satisfying, and visually pleasing. There is, however, one MAJOR issue. If you minimize or leave the app for more than a few seconds, the app completely restarts when you’re in the middle of a level. Picture this, you’ve been stuck on a level for a couple days. You’ve made several failed attempts and changed your strategy multiple times, and FINALLY you’re figuring out a strategy that’s working. This is it! You’ve got it. You get a call and leave the app for 90 seconds, and when you return, the app just restarts. All your progress? Gone. That’s strategy you finally figured out? Did you write it down? If not, I hope you have a great memory or a lot of patience because you’re back to square one. If this was fixed, (please for the love of all things good and holy devs fix this) it would be an easy 5 star game and probably my favorite mobile game ever, but as it stands it has the capacity to make you want to throw your phone across the room in frustration and not even out of difficulty, and for that reason, 3 stars is the best I can give it.

But I’m partly color-blind, which makes some levels super frustrating. I can’t easily tell the difference between the very pale blue and the white, nor between the three or more kinds of red. I lose levels often because of guessing wrong about the colors. There are a bunch of ways you could address that without making major changes to the game.

Also annoying: the cube-replacer cannons. Those were ok at first, but when I deploy four or five ant boxes, releasing a hundred or more ants, and *all* of them get replaced back to where they were, that’s really tedious.

Gaining money is way too slow (even at 500 per day from watching ads), and the boosts are way too expensive. Most of the time I can’t afford the boosts.

Also, I just had a particularly annoying bug: I used the cyclone or whatever it’s called to remove all black cubes, and then the only ant box I could play was a black one, which filled up a slot and lost me the level.

title: SHEIN ad ruining game experience
content: I’ve been playing this game for a few weeks (up to level 622) and I do like it, easy game play and each level is solvable without power ups (even if it takes a few tries to find the right way). Usually the banner ads aren’t too distracting and the other ads are easy to skip at the end of a level. However, within the last few days, there has been a new SHEIN ad that forcibly opens your web browser and is ruining the experience. I had the same ad open 7 times during one level (and I wasn’t even taking that long to solve it—maybe less than 5 minutes!). If this ad isn’t removed, I’m going to have to delete the app because it’s too annoying to deal with being kicked out of the game—especially when the level resets if you open a different app for too long and you lose a life. DEVs, please remove this ad or fix the settings so that it can’t open the website without my tapping—as every single other banner ad does. If not, you’ll probably lose more and more players the more annoying this experience becomes.
